statement: The complete Crouzeix conjecture. Resolves the complete Crouzeix conjecture: for every bounded operator A on a complex Hilbert space and every finite matrix-valued polynomial P, one has $`\lVert P[A]\rVert\le2\sup_{z\in W(A)}\lVert P(z)\rVert`$, where $`W(A)`$ is the numerical range. The constant 2 is sharp, independent of the matrix size, and valid in infinite dimensions.
